summary: Iteration 7 full-stack test. Backend: 12/13 pytest tests passed (1 skipped - no /api/categories endpoint) covering chat->vault, profile/from-documents, loans/checklist, secure share lifecycle (create/list/access/file/zip/revoke), 403 wrong-pw, 404 unknown token+revoked, 410 expired (verified via direct DB-inserted expired share), 400 empty share, and the delete-404 fixes for /documents/{unknown} + /investments/{unknown}. Frontend: login + all 10 nav routes load clean; TEXT PREVIEW FIX verified (source chip -> preview-text <pre> renders .txt content, Download present); chat upload appears in Vault; profile auto-fill works (extracted full_name/DOB/nationality/passport no+expiry/visa from a passport .txt, non-clobbering, friendly 404 toast when no docs); Loan Prep builds a 32-item checklist with have/missing + pre-selected vault docs and creates a share with 8-digit password and 15-day expiry; PUBLIC /share/:token page in a fresh no-login context rejects wrong password ('Incorrect password' toast, form stays), unlocks with the correct password, lists docs, shows Download all (.zip) and renders text preview; Vault category select has all 20 categories incl. Travel + Big Purchase; regression: multi-file upload + AI auto-classify, insurance modal, money insights, vault delete all pass. One HIGH functional bug found: unrelated plain-chat questions still get vault documents attached as sources.

critical.issue: False document grounding. Token matching uses naive substring match of every >=3-char word incl. stopwords ('the', 'about', 'one'), so unrelated questions pull private docs into context. Verified: 'Tell me a fun fact about the ocean.' -> bank statement attached and the reply volunteered the user's salary/rent/SIP data; 'what is compound interest?' also produced a sources chip in the UI. Regression vs the 'plain chat shows NO sources' requirement and a privacy concern. Fix: drop stopwords, match whole words (regex \b) and/or require score >= 2 or an explicit doc-intent keyword.

minor.issue: Matching is too loose: `(cat and d.category == cat) or any(token in hay)` matches EVERY doc in a category, so a single identity .txt (it7_passport.txt) was marked 'You have this' for PAN Card, Aadhaar Card, Passport-size Photographs and 'Chain of Property Documents'. Produces false 'have' statuses. Suggest requiring name-token overlap in filename/metadata (not category alone) or labelling category-only hits as 'possible match'.
expiry_days <= 0 silently falls back to 15 days instead of a 422/400 validation error (pydantic Field(gt=0) would be clearer).

No rate limiting / attempt lockout on the public unlock endpoint; an 8-digit numeric password (10^8 space) is brute-forceable. Share password is also stored in plaintext in mongo and echoed by GET /api/shares. Consider throttling + hashing.
Endpoint does not exist (404); category list is duplicated between backend deps.DOC_CATEGORIES and frontend lib/categories.js - drift risk.

ui_bugs.issue: React dev console warning: 'In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <option> ... will cause a hydration error' on /insights. Cosmetic/dev-only but should be cleaned (option children must be plain text).

integration_issues.issue: message-sources chip rendered for a generic finance question because the backend attached an unrelated vault doc (see backend HIGH issue). Frontend wiring is correct; fix is server-side.

action_items: HIGH: Tighten select_relevant_docs (stopword removal, whole-word match, min score) so plain chat does not attach unrelated vault documents / leak financial data into generic answers.
MEDIUM: Tighten loan checklist matching so category-only hits are not reported as 'You have this' (false positives observed for PAN card / photographs / property docs).
LOW: Validate expiry_days > 0 on POST /api/shares; add throttling on POST /api/shares/{token}/access; consider hashing the share password.
LOW: Remove the <span> inside <option> on the Insights statement select (React hydration warning).
OPTIONAL: expose category list from backend (single source of truth) instead of duplicating in lib/categories.js.
critical_code_review_comments: routes.py is 796 lines (>700) - split chat/documents/insights/investments into modules.
select_relevant_docs uses substring token matching over a JSON dump of metadata; this is both imprecise and a privacy risk - move to word-boundary matching with a stopword list.
Loan checklist match rule `(cat and d.category == cat) or any(token in hay)` OR-combines a very broad predicate; needs scoring.
Share password is plaintext in mongo and returned in list responses; public access endpoint lacks brute-force protection.
Duplicate text-preview logic in Chat.jsx and SharedView.jsx (~15 lines) - extract a shared preview component/hook.

success_rate.frontend: 95% (all iteration-7 flows pass; 1 grounded-chat regression surfaced from backend)

Expired-share 410 can only be tested by inserting a share with a past expires_at (see it7_expiry_check.py) because the API clamps expiry_days<=0 to 15 days. Re-verify plain-chat-no-sources after the select_relevant_docs fix and re-check loan checklist 'have' accuracy with a mixed doc set.
rca_of_the_issue: Root cause of false chat grounding: routes.py select_relevant_docs tokenizes the query with r'[a-z0-9]{3,}' (keeping stopwords like 'the', 'about', 'one') and scores docs by plain substring containment in filename+category+json.dumps(metadata). Common stopwords appear inside metadata text, so score>0 for arbitrary questions and up to 3 documents get uploaded into the LLM context. Reproduction: new conversation -> ask 'Tell me a fun fact about the ocean.' with any bank statement in the vault -> reply cites the user's transactions and the UI renders message-sources.
